The CI failure occurred because downstream services still rely on the legacy field names under the cross-service schema contract (ARCH-4):
- `analytics-ingest` requires `placedAt`
- `billing-service` requires `totalCents`

To resolve this while matching the Payments and Customer APIs, [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L28) now supports both the new names (`amountCents`, `createdAt`) and the legacy aliases (`totalCents`, `placedAt`):

### Changes
1. **[src/core/events.ts](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L59)**:
   - Added `createdAt` and `amountCents` to [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L28).
   - Retained `placedAt` and `totalCents` as legacy aliases for backwards compatibility.
   - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L44-L61) to populate both the new and legacy fields.

2. **[test/app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/test/app.test.ts#L21-L35)** & **[test/adapters.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/test/adapters.test.ts#L46-L55)**:
   - Updated tests to verify that both `createdAt`/`amountCents` and `placedAt`/`totalCents` are published.

- `npm run typecheck` passed cleanly.
- `npm run arch` passed with no dependency violations.
- `npm test` passed all 39 tests.
